scientific_integrity: Proof provides explicit equivariant nerve and invariant cone; known Frattini reduction and solvable-group sphere theorem credited. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd dihedral n>=3 only; uninspected Welker 1995 and Thévenaz 1985 full text leave originality risk; cannot extend to even n or unreduced cones; finite checks are not infinite proof.
title: Affine-equivariant Frattini-core homotopy of odd dihedral groups
